analyst_view.overall: Marseille (31st, 3 points) host Levski Sofia (10th, 7 points) at the Velodrome and need a win to keep slim knockout hopes alive. Their four-game winning run ended on Sunday with a 3-2 home defeat by promoted Le Mans after leading 2-0; Bruno Genesio spoke of second-half collapses in the last three home games and missed Pierre-Emile Hojbjerg, who was ill (no return date given, but illness is usually short). Emerson and Derek Cornelius are long-term absentees already in the numbers. Levski beat Lokomotiv Sofia 4-1 at the weekend, but key midfielder Serginho (4 goals, 8 assists) will probably miss the trip with a minor injury, and striker Stephane and Radoslav Kirilov are also out; only Kirilov is in the numbers' missing list. No referee is named yet; I lean slightly lower on goals and shots on target for Levski's weakened attack.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.3 goals, 2.4 for Marseille and 0.8 for Levski, and already lift Levski a little for Emerson's absence. Levski will likely be without Serginho, their main creator, and striker Stephane, neither in the missing list, which trims their small share; Marseille's late defensive lapses (3 conceded to Le Mans) are partly in their recent record already. I go mildly lower, to about 3.2.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.5 corners, 6.9 for Marseille. Levski usually defend deep away from home, which pushes corners Marseille's way, but that is in the numbers already, as is both teams' lower recent corner count. I stay at about 9.5.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.2 cards and already lower Levski for few bookings lately (-5.1%) and raise Marseille (+4.9%). No referee is named yet; a frustrated Marseille side under pressure could pick up a card or two, but nothing concrete points that way, so I stay at about 4.2.

shots.text: The numbers say 27.5 shots, 18.6 for Marseille, already trimmed for their lower recent shot count (-6.9%). Marseille need the win and should have long spells of pressure, while Levski without Serginho may shoot less, but they rarely shoot much away anyway, so I stay at about 27.5.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 10.1 on target, 7.2 for Marseille, and already trim Marseille for poor recent accuracy (-6.8%). Levski's attack loses Serginho and Stephane, which takes a little off their 2.9, so I go slightly lower, to about 9.9.
